title: Toast
description: Temporary notifications with a title, a description and a status, shown with toast() from anywhere (no React context needed) and rendered by a ToastProvider inside your app tree. Unlike message, toasts inherit your app's context (theme, locale) and showing a toast with an existing id replaces it. Server rendering is safe.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Mount one ToastProvider near the root (this demo mounts the one used on this page), then call toast.success / error / warning / info.

options.title: Options
options.description: toast({ status, title, description, duration }) for full control; duration 0 keeps the toast until it is closed. toast.dismiss(id) closes one toast, toast.dismiss() all of them. Hovering or focusing a toast pauses its timer.

dedupe.title: Same id replaces
dedupe.description: Showing a toast with the id of a visible one replaces it and restarts its timer, instead of stacking duplicates (handy for polling errors). useToast returns the same toast function.

ToastOptions.id: Identifier of the toast; generated when omitted. Showing a toast with the id of a visible one replaces it (and restarts its timer) instead of stacking a duplicate
ToastOptions.title: Main text
ToastOptions.duration: Time in milliseconds before the toast closes automatically; 0 keeps it open

ToastProviderProps.children: Application content; the toast viewport is rendered after it
ToastProviderProps.pauseOnHover: Pauses the auto-close timer while a toast is hovered or focused
ToastProviderProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the toast region
ToastProviderProps.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close buttons

ToastApi.info: Shows an info toast with the given title
ToastApi.success: Shows a success toast with the given title
ToastApi.warning: Shows a warning toast with the given title
ToastApi.error: Shows a danger toast with the given title
ToastApi.dismiss: Closes the toast with the given id, or every toast when omitted
